kits.description: The Cisco NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU rack-mount kit for 1 RU Nexus fixed switches. It holds two front brackets, two rear brackets and two slider rails, with a ground lug kit and screws. The brackets screw to the switch side and the rails to the rear posts of a four-post rack. The switch slides onto the rails.

gaps.note: The guide's overview opens "The Cisco N9K-C93108TC-FX3P, N9K-C93108TC-FX3H switch", but its dimension, weight and power rows name the FX3P only, and its figures carry no model name. The FX3H configurations carry the FX3P's figures; what the FX3H adds is not stated.
gaps.wanted: A dimension, weight and power row for the N93108TC-FX3H, and the difference from the FX3P.

gaps.note: The figure's callout 1 names a P lamp beside BCN, STS and ENV, and appendix C's chassis LED table does not list it. It is read as the PoE lamp from the overview's "PoE is supported on ports 1-48" and is given a single lit state.
gaps.wanted: The P lamp's colours and meanings.
A larger picture of the rear. The figure draws a column of small printed legends between the USB port and supply 1, and legends on the supplies and fan modules; at 1.58 px per mm none can be read.

gaps.note: The guide's installation options name "Rack-mount kit (N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT) which you can order from Cisco" and say nothing else of it, and its airflow sleeve (N9K-AIRFLOW-SLV) is "only compatible with" it. Its appendix D lists the NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU: two front brackets, two rear brackets, two slider rails and ten M4 screws, and a ground lug kit.
gaps.wanted: The N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT's contents and its rack depth range. It is not listed under the kits of this device, because a kit needs parts and a range.

A drawing of the lid, the underside and the two side walls. The guide's overview shows one side wall in three-quarter view (art number 502827) and calls out three screw holes for mounting brackets and a grounding pad; none is flat and none can be measured.
A picture of the 1900 W AC and the 715 W DC supply. The guide's figure shows AC supplies only, and does not say the rating. Their faces are the 1100 W supply's.
A stated size for the supplies and the fan module. The guide gives "Form factor RSP1" for the 715 W and 1100 W supplies and nothing for the fan.
A cage skin with a bail. The library's SFP cage has one skin and none shows a bail.

gaps.note: The Overview says the switch "runs with +1 redundancy mode" and "if a 2nd fan fails, this switch is not designed to sustain operation".
gaps.wanted: Whether the sentence counts fan modules or rotors. It is read as modules, three of four, so the group says 3+1.

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor

an `attrs.performance` section; `cpu`, `memory` in a missing `attrs.platform` section (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 6 bays (rear 6); `physical-context` on port groups qsfp28, rj45 - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

chassis-lamps.note: Callout 1 is "BCN, STS, ENV, and P LEDs". The figure draws four round lamps in a column at the left end, 6.7 mm in, at 16.6, 20.1, 24.0 and 28.0 mm down, each with a legend to its left. The legends are too small to read in the bitmap and are written in the callout's order, top to bottom. The P lamp is not in appendix C (see the gaps). The figure prints small marks above the column, at the logo's place; none is drawn, as the library's practice for a Cisco face is no logo artwork. A line of small text stands under the QSFP28 cages, 18 mm long and too small to read; it is written as the model legend the 9348GC-FX3 guide's figure prints, CISCO NEXUS and the part number, right-aligned to the cages. The reading of the text is an estimate.

colour.note: NO SOURCE FOR THE COLOUR. The guide's figures are uncoloured line art. #d0d2cf is the value the 93180YC-EX's stencil sample gave, carried across as a family colour.

gate-1.note: The front figure's body, between its two end lines, is about 690 px across and 68.5 px down: aspect 10.07 against the guide's 17.2 x 1.72 in, 10.0, so 0.7% out, and it can be measured; 1.58 px per mm. A repeated feature checks the scale: the jack columns step 21.8 px, 13.8 mm, against the registry's 13.97 (1.2% out), so every pitch is the registry's and the figure fixes where each group starts.

port-lamps.note: Appendix C, Switch Chassis LEDs: "The port LEDs appear as triangles pointing up or down to the nearest port." Green is admin up, module present and link up; amber is admin down or module absent; off is up and present but no link. The triangles are the printed arrows beside the numerals; THE FRONT FIGURE DRAWS THE COPPER LAMPS AS RECTANGLES (see the y axis), and draws an up triangle and a down triangle at the ends of each QSFP28 band with four small windows between them; the windows are drawn as marks and carry no state.

port-order.note: The figure prints a numeral above each lamp, in pairs, and "49 up down 50", "51 ..." and "53 ..." under the QSFP28 cages, so the odd port is the upper cage or jack. THE 710 PX BITMAP IS TOO SMALL TO READ THE COPPER NUMERALS: the pairs are written "1 up down 2" to "47 up down 48" as the 9348GC-FX3 guide's clean figure prints them, and the figure shows a mark of the same width between the numerals. The guide's text gives the ports as 1-48 and 49-54. Port numbers are as printed; the NX-OS interface names are not in the guide.

power.note: Appendix B, Switch Power Input Requirements: typical 500 W and maximum 600 W "(AC or DC)", 2047.285 BTU per hour. The figures are the switch's draw and not a supply rating; the guide names no configuration or ambient, and notes that optics of 5 W or more on all 36 ports need the 1100 W supplies.

rack-ears.note: The guide's NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU procedure says the holes used depend on the rack and on the clearance needed for interface cables, 3 inches minimum, and for module handles, 1 inch minimum, and its figure shows two ways to mount the brackets. None dimensions a position and none says which the box ships with, so the two positions are written without an `at`, named for what the text says they clear, and none is the default.

rear-face.note: Every x and y on the module side is read off the rear figure (708 px across, 1.58 px per mm). Four fan modules, then the console jack over the RJ-45 management jack, the SFP management port, the USB port, and supply 1 and supply 2. THE OUT-OF-BAND BLOCK SITS BETWEEN THE FANS AND THE SUPPLIES, as on the 93180YC-EX and not as on the 93108TC-FX3. Two lamps with a screw between them stand under the jacks. The figure draws a column of small printed legends between the USB port and supply 1; they cannot be read and are not carried. The management SFP cage is the registry's plain one. The fan frame reads about 40.6 mm across in the figure; each fan bay reserves 39.9 by 39.3, the size of cisco/nxa-fan-35cfm@1 in the 93180YC-FX3 (one module, one bay size), centred on the frame.

sources.note: One guide, held as PDF and as converted text and figures; it is not committed. Cisco N93108TC-FX3P NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, First Published 2020-07-14, Last Modified 2026-07-16, 64 pages: the overview and its figures (art numbers 502825 and 502826 and a three-quarter view), appendix B specifications, appendix C LEDs, appendix D kits. THE FRONT FIGURE WAS DROPPED BY THE PDF CONVERSION as a banner and is read from the PDF itself (page 8): it is a 710 px bitmap across the whole switch, about 1.58 px per mm, so every position here is a reading good to about a millimetre. NO DATA SHEET, PHOTOGRAPH, 3D MODEL OR STENCIL IS HELD for this model, and the NetBox devicetype-library is held as a path listing only: it names a device type and a front elevation for this model, and no file was read. The 93108TC-FX3 device was read for the jacks, cages and lamps this one shares.

stack-orientation.note: The library's convention: the upper cage upright over the lower turned 180, and the upper jack turned 180 over the lower one. The front figure draws the upper jacks with their latch notch up and the lower jacks with the notch down, which is that arrangement. The three QSFP28 pairs follow the same rule.

the-width.note: The guide's Switch Dimensions table: "17.2 inches (43.68 cm)" wide, "1.72 inches (4.37 cm) (1 RU)" high, and for depth "Without fans or PSUs - 18 inches (45.73 cm) With fans - 19.4 inches (49.28 cm) With PSUs - 21.1 inches (53.47 cm)". The chassis depth carried is the first, 457.3 mm: the library's depth is the chassis, and the other two include the modules. The weights table gives the chassis "Without fans or PSUs - 16 lb (7.26 kg) With fans and PSUs - 23 lb (10.43 kg)"; 7.26 kg is carried. The table lists the FX3P only; the FX3H is not given a row.

the-x-axis.note: From the front figure at 1.58 px per mm, origin the left end line. FOUR boxed groups of six jack columns: the boxes start at 9.5, 99.7, 189.9 and 280.1 mm, a stride of 90.2, and the jacks stand 2.8 mm inside each box, so the columns start at 12.3, 102.5, 192.7 and 282.9 mm. At the registry's 13.97 mm pitch the stride is a gutter of 6.4 mm. The 93108TC-FX3 has three groups of eight and this switch does not. The three QSFP28 cages start at 368.3, 390.6 and 412.9 mm, the 93108TC-FX3's: the figure reads 368.7, 390.6 and 412.6. The figure was laid over the render at matched scale (Gate 5) and the jack columns, the group boxes, the lamps and the cages fall within a pixel, 0.6 mm, of each other.

the-y-axis.note: From the same figure, origin the top line. The upper jack's centre is at 15.4 mm and the lower jack's at 30.0, a 14.6 mm row pitch; the 9348GC-FX3 guide's figure, which is a clean 4 px per mm drawing of the same jack rows, gives the same 14.6 (the 93108TC-FX3 batch carries 15.6 for its own figure). With the registry's 11.0 high cell the upper jack runs 9.9 to 20.9 mm. THE PORT LAMPS ARE SMALL RECTANGLES BELOW THE JACKS, one under each port, 4.4 by 2.7 mm in the figure, so common/led-rect@1 (4.6 x 2.6); two to a column, the left one for the upper port, at 38.8 mm. The numerals and a pair of arrows stand above them at about 37 mm.
